pages.text: Dimensional Dungeons chests have dedicated combat rewards. Ordinary rooms provide supplies and a chance for an Apotheosis gem or affix item. Hard chests guarantee such a find; the most dangerous treasure adds Gem Dust for gem upgrades.

Citadel and Abyss treasuries contain $(thing)an affix item and a gem$(). Their rarity and properties follow your available $(thing)Apotheosis World Tier$(). More dangerous dungeons provide more valuable finds within your tier.

Native dungeon keys, crowns, enscribers and trophies remain protected. New rewards apply when chest contents first generate. Reusing an old dungeon key does not refill treasure that has already been opened.
